title: Logger prefixes and flags
hints: log.New(out, prefix, flags): the prefix is written exactly as given, so include the separator yourself ("app: "). log.LstdFlags adds the date and time.
Flags of 0 means no date or time. log.Lshortfile adds file:line, the place in the code where the log call was made.
By default the prefix comes before file:line. log.Lmsgprefix moves it to just before the message: log.Lshortfile|log.Lmsgprefix.
